messages:
Nina: Quick sync  I'm landing a small docs change to standardize wording around audit exports and pseudonymization. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4921. Need a quick legal/security read.
Omar: Can you paste the short top-level blurb you'll use? I want to check it's clear for engs who automate exports.
Nina: Draft blurb:
"Audit exports provide event-level telemetry for tenant auditing and troubleshooting. By default, personal identifiers (for example, email addresses) are pseudonymized in exported artifacts. Tenants may request inclusion of original identifiers; such requests must be authorized and are recorded in the tenant audit trail. Retention: default 365 days; records under legal hold remain until released. Exports are encrypted in transit and at rest."
Priya: Legal: replace "may request" with "may request inclusion of original identifiers; such requests must be authorized and are recorded." Also prefer "personal identifiers" over "PII" in public docs. Avoid the term "anonymous" if we can't guarantee irreversibility.
Marco: Security: add a parenthetical: "(mapping export available only to tenant admins and requires explicit consent)" so auditors know mappings are controlled.
Nina: Good, updating. Also adding two migration snippets per Kevin's ask: a curl + python example and a tiny CSV sample so product teams see output mapping.
Omar: Nice. For curl show the new flag `pseudonymize` instead of old `redact_personal` so folks can sed-replace scripts.
Nina: Curl example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"tenant_id":"t_77","since":"2026-02-01","pseudonymize":true}'
```
Python example:
```python
# export with pseudonymization
client.audit.export(tenant_id='t_77', since='2026-02-01', pseudonymize=True)
```
CSV sample row shown in docs: `timestamp,tenant,actor,action,tokens,request_id`
`2026-02-15T18:12:03Z,t_77,end_user_pseudo_42,model.generate,128,req_ab12`
Priya: Also include a short CI test snippet suggestion: assert exported CSV contains no email regex when pseudonymize=True. Example: `assert not re.search(r"[\w.+-]+@[\w.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}", output)`
Marco: And add a line: "Masking or pseudonymization is not a substitute for access controls; see Data Retention Policy."
Nina: Done. Also noticed a broken anchor in the export-playbook link (audit-export-format -> audit-export-guidance). I'll include the redirect in this PR.
deploy-bot: docs-deploy: staging preview available for branch docs/audit-phrasing-4921 - https://staging.redwood.ai/docs/audit-export (expires in 48h)
legal-bot: reminder: include link to Legal Hold runbook and SOC2 control mapping appendix.
Nina: Linking both and pushing final tweaks. I'll request final sign-off from Marco/Priya once CI preview passes. Thanks everyone :pray:
